messages:
alex: Quick async check-in — started prod feature-flag ramp for `delta-scheduling` at 23:00 UTC (1%). Did: smoke tests, heartbeat pings. Blocker: small 5xx bump on NodeGroup B. Pausing ramp until we triage. @sre-bot fyi.

sre-bot: alert: 5xx rate +2.4% vs baseline on NodeGroup B since 23:15 UTC. Top HTTP code 502. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/metrics?span=1h&panel=5xx

lina: saw the alert. Traces point to router->runtime timeouts ~120ms higher for a subset of requests (same model shard). Can we get a sample request id to follow?

alex: sample req id 01F9Z7-ax3. Example payload short: `{ "prompt_len": 64, "model": "rwd-7b-q4" }`. No PII.

kevin: looking. Early signal shows kernel selection fallback on host-12 causing jitter (quantized variant). Pulling runtime logs: `journalctl -u redwood-runtime --since "23:00" | grep 01F9Z7` and `rdwctl get-kernellog host-12`.

maria: product here — request to hold at 1% unless we confirm no user-visible regressions. If we pause, how fast is rollback?

alex: pause/rollback plan: use internal flagctl. Command to pause: `./flagctl set delta-scheduling --env=prod --pct=0.01 --note="pause after 1% spike"` — to stop entirely: `--pct=0.0`. Changes are immediate (~5s to propagate).

kevin: I pushed a routing tweak to bias traffic to NodeGroup A for 30m while we investigate (deploy id `deploy_2026_03_15_014`). This is a temporary routing policy change, not a full rollback. Monitoring now.

qa_sam: running the A/B smoke suite (200 prompts) against both groups. No semantic regressions so far; latency distributions show +30ms median on NodeGroup B. Attaching short summary to the ticket.

alex: plan: hold ramp at 1% for 30m. If 5xx drop to <0.5% delta and latency stabilizes, resume to 5%. If not, we rollback to 0% and open postmortem. Will update in 20m. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lina: adding a monitor to fire if NodeGroup B 5xx > 1% for next 15m. Also enabling extra sampling on router traces for req ids with `01F9Z7` prefix.

kevin: noted — will stream host-12 runtime logs to the incident channel for the next 20m.

maria: thanks — product happy with holding. Keep us posted, especially if rollback time < 10m.

alex: update 23:45 UTC — 5xx trending down to +0.6%. continuing hold; next update 00:00 UTC.
